title: remove_at function for PackedVector2Array does not remove negative indexes
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot Engine v4.7.stable.official.5b4e0cb0f
- Reproducible Godot Engine v4.1.stable.official.970459615

### System information

Debian 13

### Issue description

When trying to remove negative indexes from PackedVector2Array I will get an error saying:
`E 0:00:00:268   node.gd:7 @ _ready(): Index p_index = -1 is out of bounds (prev_size = 2).
  <C++ Source>  ./core/templates/cowdata.h:275 @ remove_at()
  <Stack Trace> node.gd:7 @ _ready()
`

While it is not mentioned in the [documentation of PackedVector2Array](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.7/classes/class_packedvector2array.html#class-packedvector2array-method-remove-at) that removing negative indexes is supported, I think its not unreasonable to expect a parity with `remove_at` function in `Array`. Maybe the docs for PackedVector2Array could be updated to explicitly mention that `remove_at` function doesnt work like its counterpart for `Array`? I'm not sure but i think at least updating docs for PackedVector2Array to look more like [docs for Array](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.7/classes/class_array.html#class-array-method-remove-at) wouldn't hurt.


Please let me know if this is an actual bug.


### Steps to reproduce

Create empty scene
```gdscript
var packed_array: PackedVector2Array = [Vector2.ZERO, Vector2.ONE]

func _ready() -> void:
	packed_array.remove_at(-1)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[remove-at-issue.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31182013/remove-at-issue.tar.gz)
